analysis:
All units are tests or fixtures. None is a production change, so no regression is provable from them alone. They do imply new production behavior that integration must verify.

(1) RegistrationWeightHashTests.swift lines 28-52 imply that registrationWeightHash (darkbloom CLI) reuses a recorded hash for managed GLM models on restart without reading the weights. The record is stored in a verified-weights.json file. Line 44 states that any write to a hashed file forces a rehash.
- Relevant threats: T-012/T-027 (operator weight substitution, ADV-001) and TB-003.
- Integration must check what the record is keyed on (size/mtime/inode/ctime, or a content-derived signal). It must also check whether the record file's location and permissions are operator-writable.
- An operator could otherwise forge metadata or edit the record so that the provider self-reports a stale or chosen weight hash for substituted weights. That would weaken an already self-reported, fail-open control (SEC-007).
- Only glm5_next uses the record. Lines 54-74 show other models and a nil record path always rehash.

(2) PageCacheTests.swift shows that WeightHasher.hashSingleFile now drops pages from the unified buffer cache (lines 44-50). This is an availability/performance concern, not a confidentiality one. Verify that the drop happens after hashing and never alters contents (line 41).

(3) GLM5NextWiredLimitTests.swift covers diagnostic advice only: sudo sysctl and a LaunchDaemon plist at /Library/LaunchDaemons (lines 66-105). Confirm that the provider only prints these and never executes them with privilege, and that the installed plist writes only to root-owned /var/log. This is analogous to the TB-010/T-045 concerns.

(4) NativeOutputControlRefusalTests.swift shows that logprobs and constraints on native engines are refused as a typed 400 instead of a 500 (lines 44-61). This avoids a consumer-triggered coordinator breaker (ADV-002 DoS). Verify that the prefix-string parsing in fromSchedulerMessage cannot be spoofed to mislabel genuine engine failures.

(5) The fixture change only adds think tokens (head lines 111-112).

The production sources for these behaviors were not supplied, which is a coverage limit.
